connector.name: Sentrysurface
connector.registryDescription: Cybersecurity MCP server for URL scanning, threat intelligence, and domain reputation.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.sentrysurface.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sentrysurface account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer header using ptnet_mcp_ key, for example: Bearer ptnet_mcp_xxx
